evidence: Adds rebroadcastwallettx RPC, wallet rebroadcast eligibility logic, and tests in src/wallet/ and test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py
rationale: Provides a direct way to manually rebroadcast stuck or dropped unconfirmed wallet transactions from RPC and GUI. It resolves a clear user friction where users previously had to manually extract raw transaction hex and call `sendrawtransaction`, but existing workarounds make it reasonably deferrable.
